content.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Python project root, environment, dependency manifest, and POSIX launchers.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        python.md, common.md
provides:     pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .venv, bin launchers
depends:
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create pyproject.toml declaring Python 3.11 or newer, pytest, and psycopg[binary] for the PostgreSQL engine. Commit uv.lock.
  Create .venv with uv venv and POSIX launchers in bin/ that activate it.
  Write ARCHITECTURE.md with the module layout, the persistence and CLI boundaries, and a Technology Stack section derived from TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md.

## story PERSIST-002
summary:      Declare the three-table schema in DATABASE.md and generate the persistence package.
type:         foundational
kind:         migration
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
covers:       PERSIST-002
accepts:      st-009
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     accounts, categories, transactions
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare accounts, categories, and transactions with the keys and references from the Database section. Amounts are INTEGER cents.
  Declare one access pattern for each table operation the commands need.
  The DATABASE step writes no application code. Drydock generates the persistence package and schema.sql.

## story PERSIST-001
summary:      Resolve the database target from DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PATH, or data/app.db.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-DatabaseTarget.md
covers:       PERSIST-001
accepts:      st-009
stack:        python.md
provides:     database target resolution
consumes:     open_database
depends:      PERSIST-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve DATABASE_URL first, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db.
  A postgres:// or postgresql:// value is passed to open_database unchanged. Other values are SQLite paths with an optional sqlite:// prefix.
  Open the store only through persistence.open_database.

## story CLI-003
summary:      Provide the ledger executable at the application root.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliEntry.md
covers:       CLI-003
stack:        cli.md, python.md
provides:     ledger executable, cli.main
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Build the cli package with main(argv) -> int and cli_runner, per the platform contract.
  Add an executable file named ledger at the application root that calls cli.main and exits with its return value.

## story CLI-001
summary:      Dispatch commands and reject usage errors with exit 2.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliDispatch.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        cli.md
provides:     command dispatch, usage errors, per-command help
depends:      CLI-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Route each command word to its handler. An unknown command, unknown table or report, or wrong argument count exits 2 with one stderr line.
  Every command has help text. ledger --help and ledger <command> --help print usage to stdout and exit 0. No arguments writes one usage line to stderr and exits 2.

## story CLI-002
summary:      Write CSV success output and failure diagnostics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliOutput.md
covers:       CLI-002
stack:        python.md
provides:     CSV output writer, diagnostic line writer
depends:      CLI-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the header and rows as CSV with no quoting, no trailing spaces, and newline line endings.
  init writes nothing. A failing command writes nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.

## story VALID-001
summary:      Validate codes, names, descriptions, and memos.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ValidateText.md
covers:       VALID-001
stack:        python.md
provides:     code, name, and memo validators
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Codes are 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9. Names and descriptions are 1 to 40 characters. Memos are 0 to 60 characters. None may contain a comma or newline.
  A violation is rejected with exit 3.

## story VALID-002
summary:      Validate and format amounts as integer cents.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ValidateAmount.md
covers:       VALID-002
stack:        python.md
provides:     amount parser, amount formatter
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Input matches -?DIGITS[.D[D]], is never zero, and has at most two decimals. Parse it to integer cents without floating point.
  Output has exactly two decimals and a leading - when negative. A violation is rejected with exit 3.

## story VALID-003
summary:      Validate calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ValidateDate.md
covers:       VALID-003
stack:        python.md
provides:     date validator
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Accept only real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD. 2026-02-30 is rejected with exit 3.

## story INTEG-001
summary:      Run each command as one database transaction.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CommandTransaction.md
covers:       INTEG-001
accepts:      st-007
stack:        python.md
provides:     command transaction wrapper
depends:      PERSIST-001, PERSIST-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Wrap every command in one database transaction. Any failure rolls back every table.
  Rely on the database's own transaction isolation. Add no locking.

## story INTEG-002
summary:      Reject any command that would leave an account balance below zero.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance.md
covers:       INTEG-002
accepts:      st-008
stack:        python.md
provides:     non-negative balance check
depends:      INTEG-001
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  After a command's changes and before commit, compute each affected account balance as the sum of its transaction amounts.
  Any balance below zero rejects the command with exit 3 and changes nothing.

## story PERSIST-003
summary:      Initialize an empty schema with ledger init.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-InitSchema.md
covers:       PERSIST-003
accepts:      st-003
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger init
depends:      PERSIST-001, PERSIST-002, INTEG-001, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  ledger init drops accounts, categories, and transactions if present, creates them empty, and writes nothing.
  A missing SQLite file is created empty by the first command. A command that finds no tables exits 1 with nothing on stdout.

## story PERSIST-004
summary:      Count table rows with ledger count.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CountRows.md
covers:       PERSIST-004
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger count
depends:      PERSIST-003, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  ledger count writes table,rows, then the accounts, categories, and transactions rows, each computed by a query.

## story LOAD-001
summary:      Load accounts from a CSV file.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md
covers:       LOAD-001
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger load accounts
depends:      INTEG-001, VALID-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Accept a file whose header matches account,name. Load all rows or none, and write table,loaded then accounts,<rows>.

## story LOAD-002
summary:      Load categories from a CSV file.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LoadCategories.md
covers:       LOAD-002
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger load categories
depends:      INTEG-001, VALID-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Accept a file whose header matches category,description. Load all rows or none, and write table,loaded then categories,<rows>.

## story LOAD-003
summary:      Load transactions from a CSV file, keeping each txn_id.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md
covers:       LOAD-003
accepts:      st-004, st-007
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger load transactions
depends:      LOAD-001, LOAD-002, INTEG-002, VALID-001, VALID-002, VALID-003, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Accept a file whose header lists the transaction columns in the Commands order. Keep each txn_id. Any rejected row rejects the file, which stores no rows.
  An unreadable file exits 1. Write table,loaded then transactions,<rows>.

## story ACCT-001
summary:      Add an account.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-AccountAdd.md
covers:       ACCT-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger account add
depends:      INTEG-001, VALID-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the new account row with balance 0.00. A duplicate code or invalid field exits 3.

## story ACCT-002
summary:      Get an account with its transaction count and balance.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-AccountGet.md
covers:       ACCT-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger account get
depends:      ACCT-001, VALID-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the account row with its transaction count and balance computed by query. An absent code exits 4.

## story ACCT-003
summary:      Rename an account.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-AccountRename.md
covers:       ACCT-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger account rename
depends:      INTEG-001, VALID-001, ACCT-002, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Change only the name and write the updated row. An absent code exits 4. An invalid name exits 3.

## story ACCT-004
summary:      Delete an account that has no transactions.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-AccountDelete.md
covers:       ACCT-004
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger account delete
depends:      INTEG-001, VALID-001, ACCT-002, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Refuse with exit 3 while the account has transactions. Otherwise delete it and write deleted and the code. An absent code exits 4.

## story TXN-001
summary:      Post a transaction.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TxnPost.md
covers:       TXN-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger txn post
depends:      ACCT-001, INTEG-002, VALID-001, VALID-002, VALID-003, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assign id one more than the largest txn_id, or 1 in an empty table. An unknown account or category exits 3.
  A posted transaction with no memo writes an empty final memo field.

## story TXN-002
summary:      Get a transaction by id.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TxnGet.md
covers:       TXN-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger txn get
depends:      TXN-001, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the transaction row. An absent id exits 4.

## story TXN-003
summary:      Amend a transaction amount.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TxnAmend.md
covers:       TXN-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger txn amend
depends:      TXN-002, INTEG-002, VALID-002, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Change only the amount and write the updated row. An absent id exits 4. A negative balance exits 3.

## story TXN-004
summary:      Delete a transaction.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TxnDelete.md
covers:       TXN-004
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger txn delete
depends:      TXN-002, INTEG-002, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Delete the transaction and write deleted and the id. An absent id exits 4. A negative balance exits 3.

## story XFER-001
summary:      Transfer between two accounts as two linked rows.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Transfer.md
covers:       XFER-001
accepts:      st-007
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger transfer
depends:      ACCT-001, INTEG-002, VALID-001, VALID-002, VALID-003, CLI-001, CLI-002
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write two TRANSFER rows: -amount on the source with memo transfer to <to>, then +amount on the destination with memo transfer from <from>.
  The amount must be positive and the accounts must differ. A rejected transfer stores neither row.

## story RPT-001
summary:      Report account balances.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ReportBalances.md
covers:       RPT-001
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger report balances
depends:      LOAD-003, ACCT-003, ACCT-004, TXN-003, TXN-004, XFER-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write one row per account ordered by code, then TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>, computed from the database. An empty accounts table writes TOTAL,,0,0.00.

## story RPT-002
summary:      Report category totals.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ReportCategories.md
covers:       RPT-002
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger report categories
depends:      LOAD-003, ACCT-003, ACCT-004, TXN-003, TXN-004, XFER-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write every category ordered by code, including categories with no transactions, then the TOTAL row. Compute inflow, outflow, and net from the database.

## story RPT-003
summary:      Report monthly totals.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md
covers:       RPT-003
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md
provides:     ledger report monthly
depends:      LOAD-003, ACCT-003, ACCT-004, TXN-003, TXN-004, XFER-001, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write one row per YYYY-MM with transactions, ascending, then the TOTAL row. An empty transactions table writes TOTAL,0,0.00,0.00,0.00 with no month rows.

## story VERIFY-001
summary:      Provide bin/test.sh, the POSIX runner for the application's pytest suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TestSuite.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
depends:      foundation, CLI-003, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-001, PERSIST-002, PERSIST-003, PERSIST-004, VALID-001, VALID-002, VALID-003, INTEG-001, INTEG-002, LOAD-001, LOAD-002, LOAD-003, ACCT-001, ACCT-002, ACCT-003, ACCT-004, TXN-001, TXN-002, TXN-003, TXN-004, XFER-001, RPT-001, RPT-002, RPT-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  bin/test.sh runs pytest -q from the application root against a temporary database and exits zero only when every test passes.
  The suite covers each command, each exit code, and each rule against a real temporary database.

## story VERIFY-002
summary:      Pass the complete supplied grader, sh sources/run.sh.
type:         feature
kind:         integration
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LedgerAcceptance.md
covers:       VERIFY-002
accepts:      st-001
stack:        common.md
provides:     end-to-end grader pass
depends:      VERIFY-001, foundation, CLI-003, CLI-001, CLI-002, PERSIST-001, PERSIST-002, PERSIST-003, PERSIST-004, VALID-001, VALID-002, VALID-003, INTEG-001, INTEG-002, LOAD-001, LOAD-002, LOAD-003, ACCT-001, ACCT-002, ACCT-003, ACCT-004, TXN-001, TXN-002, TXN-003, TXN-004, XFER-001, RPT-001, RPT-002, RPT-003
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assemble the finished ledger and gate on sh sources/run.sh from the application root, which must exit zero with all 43 checks passing.
  This is the terminal story. It runs after every other story and after VERIFY-001.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
